about: The space station's shop in Secure the Base. Fly within `station.reach` of home base and press E to open it; your ship brakes to a stop while it is open (`station.brake`, higher stops faster) but the game keeps running, and it warns you when an enemy is within `station.warn_range`. You start with `start.credits` credits, `start.drills` drills, the weapons in `start.weapons`, `start.missiles` missiles and no shield. Each item's `price` is in credits. Drills: you can own up to `max` at once (carried plus set). Missiles come `pack` at a time, up to `max` carried. Health restores `restores` of your hull. Mines are bought one at a time, up to `max` carried (no limit on how many are laid). Each sentry kind has a price per tier (`prices`, tiers 1 to 3); how they fight is in combat.json's `sentries` block. `upgrades` each have 3 levels bought in order, at `prices`. Shield: `strength` is how much it soaks up, and after `delay` seconds without a hit it refills at `regen` per second. Armor: `block` is the share of each hull hit it stops, from your starting armor (the first number) to level 3, and `mass` multiplies your ship's mass (heavier armor is slower to push around). Boost: hold Shift for `gain` more thrust and top speed; a full meter lasts `seconds` of boosting, and it refills in `refill` seconds once you've let go for `delay` seconds. Auto cannon and sniper: `damage` multiplies each hit; the sniper's `pierce` is how many enemies one round goes through. `kill_credits` is what each enemy you destroy pays, straight into your credits the moment it goes down, scaled by how dangerous it is: that's how you earn your way back if you lose every drill. `test_credits` is what the = key adds while testing (0 turns it off).
